setup.selected_matrices: Y_u,Y_d from no-proxy selected channel weights and canonical normalization
setup.spectral_condition: up and down singular-value spectra must be nondegenerate

criterion.standard_factorization: Delta_CP is proportional to J_CKM times the products of up- and down-sector squared-mass differences
criterion.no_proxy_rule: Y_u,Y_d must be computed before evaluating Delta_CP; observed CKM or mass data cannot set the matrices

verdict.next_blocker: Compute canonical selected Y_u and Y_d; then evaluate Im det([Y_uY_u^dagger,Y_dY_d^dagger]) and the singular-value spectra without using observed flavor data.
